subject: Re: Redwood Private / VPC pricing - follow up & next steps
messages:
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@ledgerworks.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-30T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood Private / VPC pricing - post-call recap

Hi Alex — great to connect earlier. Quick recap and agreed next steps from today’s discovery:

- Use case: Private VPC deployment for customer-facing document understanding and routing (low latency, PII).
- Expected production footprint: initially 3 environments (dev/stage/prod), then expand to ~8 over 12 months.
- Target latency SLO: 200–400ms p95 on small chat prompts; batching for bulk inference on nightly jobs.
- Token volumes: you indicated 60M–150M input tokens/month initially (combined) with spikes up to ~400M during month-end processing.
- Budget: Maya said a target of $10k–$25k/month for inference costs and platform licensing in year 1 (open to licensing + usage mix).

Open items / next steps:
1) Ben to send ballpark pricing (licensing + unit economics $/1M tokens) for Private/VPC, including environment counts and support tiers — by EOD tomorrow.
2) Alex to share an initial procurement contact and any compliance checklist items.
3) Marissa to scope technical support/managed onboarding options.

Attaching a lightweight price sheet and SOW template for reference. If anything above is off, flag and I’ll update.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: redwood-private-pricing-sheet.pdf (summary), redwood-sow-template.docx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@ledgerworks.com>

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, Maya Rao <maya@ledgerworks.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Private / VPC pricing - post-call recap

Thanks Ben — that matches my notes. A few clarifications:

- Token volumes: the 60M–150M is our conservative run rate for Q3. The 400M spike is month-end reconciliation and may be compressed to a smaller window (we can provide a histogram).
- Environments: we truly need isolated prod + stage at launch; dev could be shared initially. Real goal is 3 dedicated environments, scaling to 6–8 by end of year.
- Compliance: we’ll need SOC 2-type evidence and an option to push logs to our SIEM.

Procurement: procurement@ledgerworks.com is the right inbox — I’m looping Maya (CTO) for budget alignment.

Quick ask: can you include both an annual license + consumption model and a committed token volume tier pricing (with an overage rate)? That will help my finance team evaluate.

Appreciate it,
Alex
Sr. Product Manager, LedgerWorks

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@ledgerworks.com>, procurement@ledgerworks.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-30T17:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Private / VPC pricing - follow up & pricing options

Alex / Procurement team — per our call, here are two straightforward pricing constructs we commonly use for Private/VPC customers. High-level ballparks only; final pricing depends on env count, support tier, and committed volume.

Option A — Annual license + usage (recommended for predictability)
- Annual platform license: $85k/year for up to 3 environments (dev shared, stage, prod). Additional environment: $12k/year/env.
- Support: Standard (business hours) included; Premium 24x7 with 1-hour incident SLA at +$25k/year.
- Unit economics (consumption): $800 per 1M tokens (applies to model inference tokens).
- Committed volume discount: 10% off unit economics for 200M+ committed tokens/month.

Option B — Committed token tier (usage-centric)
- Commitment tiers: 100M/month at $720/1M tokens; 250M/month at $640/1M tokens; 500M/month at $560/1M tokens.
- Platform access fee: $6k/month for up to 3 environments (reduces as commitment grows).
- Premium support add-on: +$2k/month.

Other notes:
- Overages billed at 120% of tier rate.
- One-time onboarding/validation professional services (env setup, KMS integration, SOC evidence handoff): $22k flat (or SOW).
- Logs: We can route audit logs to your SIEM; if you need high-retention archival in our console that is an add-on.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa to propose technical onboarding timeline (cc’d).
- Procurement to confirm whether you prefer Option A or Option B for an initial term so I can run a draft quote.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: procurement@ledgerworks.com
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@ledgerworks.com>, Maya Rao <maya@ledgerworks.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Private / VPC pricing - procurement questions

Ben — thanks for the proposals. A few procurement items to confirm before we run this through our purchasing flow:

1) Licensing model: Do you require an annual PO for Option A (platform license) or can we sign a 12-month MSA with monthly invoices?
2) Support tiers: What are the response SLAs for Standard vs Premium? Any credits/penalties tied to SLAs?
3) Environment definition: please confirm what you count as an "environment" (number of clusters, isolation boundaries, VPCs). We need that spelled out for ops.
4) Payment terms: LedgerWorks requests Net30; are you able to accommodate Net45 for first year for budgeting flexibility?

If you can provide a short answers doc (or annotate the attached price sheet) we can move to drafting an order.

Procurement Team
LedgerWorks

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: procurement@ledgerworks.com, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@ledgerworks.com>, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-31T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood Private / VPC pricing - procurement questions and env defs

Hi Procurement team — looping in technical clarifications and SLA details below. Ben, feel free to forward this as the annotated response we discussed.

Responses (short):
1) Licensing: Option A typically executed as annual PO under our MSA; we can invoice quarterly on request. Option B (committed token tier) can be set up as a 12-month commitment with monthly invoices against committed usage.
2) Support SLAs: Standard: 8x5 email support, next-business-day response for Sev2, 4-business-hour response for Sev1 review. Premium: 24x7 phone + email, 1-hour response for Sev1, 4-hour response for Sev2. SLA credits: yes — we have service credits for failure to meet Sev1 uptime >99.5% (details in MSA).
3) Environment definition: An environment = logically isolated deployment with separate VPC peering and network routing; it normally maps to a single cluster of reserved GPU capacity. Shared dev environments are allowed but count as 0.5 env for billing if resource-shared. Production/stage each count as 1.
4) Payment terms: We can accept Net45 for the first year; standard afterwards is Net30.

Optional items:
- Onboarding: recommended 3-week engagement (included in the $22k PS or via custom SOW).
- Compliance: SOC2 evidence and integration docs are available; we’ll share a redacted pack once NDA/LOE is in place.

Next steps: Ben — I can produce an annotated pricing PDF and a statement of work draft if you confirm which option LedgerWorks prefers and an initial committed month volume.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
